collection.title: Jaguar XK XK8 1996 to 2006 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Jaguar XK8 1996 to 2006 model requires a 21" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
